children.text: Hi, I came across your post and wanted to ask if you currently have any openings for Software Engineering or AI Engineering positions. I'd be happy to learn more if there are any relevant opportunities. Thank you!

Charly | Sales / Account Executive GovTech | ONSITE Berlin, Germany | Full-time | Seed | Base+Variable

Charly builds a voice and AI assistant for municipalities. We launched 13 months ago. Today, 100+ German municipalities use Charly, covering 1.4M+ residents across 9 federal states.

We're a team of 9 (6 in engineering) with one Account Executive, and we're looking for up to three more with a focus on German-speaking countries (DE, AT, CH), but open if you think you can enter other European markets for us.

Both junior and senior candidates welcome.

Apply: https://hallocharly.de/en/careers/account-executive-govtech

children.text: Hey, sent you guys an email from logandark@logandark.net.

Voluntas | Remote | Full Time | Software Engineer

Voluntas is a trading firm written 100% in Rust. We run systematic strategies, currently specializing in prediction markets, looking to expand our systems more broadly.

We're looking for someone passionate about data collection, clean abstractions, and processing trillions of rows of data. We care about the quality of the code we write, and we prioritize time for our engineers to properly build their systems, instead of pressuring them to churn out AI generated code.

If you're interested, send an email to jobs@voluntas.io with a little bit about yourself. We'll respond with a link to our engineering challenge (in Rust).
